title: Nova First-Run Hosted API Snapshot Pack
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a focused asset bundle of getting-started visuals for the Hosted API onboarding flow. Deliverables include model selector grid with dynamic cost/latency overlays, a step-by-step request builder UI (desktop + mobile responsive variants), four language code snippets (curl, Python requests, Node fetch, Java HTTP), and two short animated GIFs that demonstrate streaming responses and model switching. Assets must be exported as production-ready PNGs and web-optimized GIFs and uploaded to the shared Figma/Drive locations. Include alt text and a short accessibility note for each image.
acceptance_criteria: Model selector: high-fidelity PNGs for desktop and mobile showing curated defaults and tier popovers (cost, latency, sample tokens)
Request builder: multi-step screenshot set and an exported source-of-truth frame in Figma with component annotations
Code snippets: tested, copy-ready examples for curl, Python (requests), Node (fetch), and Java (HttpClient) that match the UI request payloads
Streaming demo GIF: <8s showing streaming tokens in the UI and reconnect fallback indicated
All assets include accessible alt text and pass the basic color-contrast checklist
Files uploaded to Drive and corresponding entries linked in the ticket
tasks: Finalize model card designs and latency/cost microcharts (Aisha)

Export assets, run accessibility QA, and generate alt text (Aisha)
Upload assets to Drive + add Figma frame links to ticket (Liam)
Hand off to docs for integration into quickstart page and note snippet locations (PM: Carlos Mendes)
